segments.ja416:1.1: Āgamissati me pāpaṃ, āgamissati me bhayaṃ;
segments.ja416:1.3: Tadā hi calitā sākhā, manussena migena vā.
segments.ja416:2.1: Bhīruyā nūna me kāmo, avidūre vasantiyā;
segments.ja416:2.3: Karissati kisaṃ paṇḍuṃ, sāva sākhā parantapaṃ.
segments.ja416:3.3: Karissati kisaṃ paṇḍuṃ, sāva sākhā parantapaṃ.
segments.ja416:4.1: Tayā maṃ asitāpaṅgi [hasitāpaṅgi (sī. syā. pī.)], sitāni [mihitāni (sī. syā. pī.)] bhaṇitāni ca;
segments.ja416:4.3: Kisaṃ paṇḍuṃ karissanti, sāva sākhā parantapaṃ.
segments.ja416:5.1: Agamā nūna so saddo, asaṃsi nūna so tava;
segments.ja416:5.3: Akkhātaṃ nūna taṃ tena, yo taṃ sākhamakampayi.
segments.ja416:6.1: Idaṃ kho taṃ samāgamma, mama bālassa cintitaṃ;
segments.ja416:6.3: Tadā hi calitā sākhā, manussena migena vā.
segments.ja416:7.1: Tatheva tvaṃ avedesi, avañci [avajjhi (ka.)] pitaraṃ mama;
segments.ja416:7.3: Hantvā sākhāhi chādento, āgamissati me [te (syā. ka.)] bhayanti.
segments.ja416:10.1: Varagāma mahākapi bhaggava ca, daḷhadhamma sakuñjara kesavaro;
segments.ja416:10.3: Urago vidhuro puna jāgarataṃ, atha kosalādhipa parantapa cāti.
segments.ja416:12.1: Atha sattanipātamhi, vaggaṃ me bhaṇato suṇa;
segments.ja416:12.3: Kukku ca puna gandhāro, dveva guttā mahesināti.
